chart.what_the_drawing_says: After the crash and the bounce off ~60k, he is long from 62,616.3 with a stop at 61,091.7 and a target at 68,771.6, i.e. a ~4:1 long back up into the light-grey 68.8k 'bearish order block' ray; the hand-drawn arrow spells out the expected path — a small dip, then a rally straight into that block, which is where he expects supply.

claims: I'm looking for a pull back to 68.8k bearish order block as previously mentioned

indicators: purple dashed level / grey supply band
notes: Every price recorded here is read from a price-axis tag; no price is estimated from pixel position. Line-to-tag assignments for the position tool, the three black dashed levels and the 68.8k ray were verified by calibrating the axis against the 2,000-unit gridlines (86,000 at the top gridline) and measuring each drawn line's row — each matched a tag to within ~1 pixel. Ten further coloured tags are visible on the axis with no corresponding line inside the visible plot window (they belong to objects drawn outside the visible x-range, or to alerts); they are recorded with colour and marked unassigned rather than guessed. The 20/06 05:00 message and its chart also appear, cropped, at the bottom of IMG_7849.
